detail: Full summary: resolution detection only sees the active board — if a resolver entry was archived in an earlier run, its need/warning stays exempt indefinitely. Conservative direction (keeps rather than loses), but a future dismissed/expiry mechanism or archive-aware resolution check would tighten it.
